<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that Welsh-language correspondence for policyholders is missing, blocking renewals. I checked the five most similar stories and roadmap items: none address Welsh-language output or localized correspondence — the closest items (document classifier threshold, milestone notifications, bulk upload, workspace administration, claim search refinements) are unrelated in problem despite touching claims or notifications.
